items.text: OUT-001 accounts for all seven assigned scope items and all four user activities, named App/SWB expressions, one complete first connected activity, explicit App/shared versus external contributions, responsible owners and relevant checks. TBD-001/002 remain explicit until their owners decide; a final exact increment SoW is not claimed from unresolved choices. Verified by VER-001 (REQ-001; B; D decision 05; P §3).

verification.text: Inspect OUT-001 against the accepted DEL-09-06 row, seven ScopeLedger rows, objectives and D decision 05. Trace the four user activities and complete activity join to named outputs/owners/checks. Compare recorded owner answers with TBD-001/002; unresolved choices may be reported but may not masquerade as a finalized operation-specific contract.

items.text: OUT-002 identifies reviewed workflow source and revision, assumptions, inputs/tools, declared checkpoints and output/evidence expectations, and defines App-to-host adaptation and host-to-App refinement without silent same-name rebinding or loss of prior basis. Verified by VER-002 (REQ-002; P V4-WF-01…06; E V4-EXM-14).

verification.text: Examine the reusable workflow and transfer/adaptation contract against P V4-WF-01…06 and the actual App PKG-02 receiving interface. Compare source-qualified identity, reviewed original bytes, assumptions/declarations and revision history at App and host; check explicit treatment of incompatible/missing tools and checkpoints.

items.text: OUT-003 contains a completed coordinated App/host round trip: the reviewed workflow is carried to host, adapted/refined there and made usable in App, with selected/resolved, supplied, adopted and observed-behavior evidence distinguished, plus interruption and revision/replay history. Registration, fixtures or partial/unrun records alone do not fulfill this criterion. Verified by VER-003 (REQ-002; REQ-003; REQ-007; E V4-EXM-14).

verification.text: Coordinate and inspect the actual V4-EXM-14 run on the identified App and externally supplied host candidates. Follow the reviewed workflow to host refinement and back to usable App method; independently compare selected/resolved, supplied and adopted bases with observed behavior. Examine interruption and revision/replay continuity. Require completed round-trip evidence; retain incomplete or failed attempts as limitations requiring further work.

items.text: The joined evidence exercises available required tools and an explicit unsupported-capability outcome, holds a declared checkpoint when its required human act is absent despite direct autonomy, and faithfully records an actually performed human act with correct subject/actor separately from recorder. It rejects fabricated acts and success-as-acceptance/approval; content revision preserves historical acts and their changed standing without inventing current approval. Verified by VER-004 (REQ-003; REQ-004; P V4-WF-04/05; H V4-HI-25/31/32/42; E V4-EXM-14).

verification.text: Within V4-EXM-14, inspect the available-tool case and unsupported-tool outcome, then the declared checkpoint hold under granted direct autonomy. Check a real performed human act's faithful content-bound record, separately attributable actor/recorder and observed disposition; test absent/fabricated-act and operation-success misattribution negatives. Change the relevant content and inspect preserved history/current standing. Judge against the actual applicable policy without creating an always-reserved list or requiring a favorable decision.

items.text: OUT-004 differentiates proposed, received, delivered, adopted and examined external contributions with evidence and actual custody/limitations; every missing contribution has its actual owner or unresolved allocation and point of need. No human-relayed file is treated as an unobserved outside commitment or execution. Verified by VER-005 (REQ-005; D J/O; H §1/11; C DEP-001).

verification.text: Trace OUT-004 from human-relayed questions/proposals through any actually received answers, contribution identities, adoption evidence and observed results. Compare claimed standing with source and receipt evidence; mark missing answers, delivery, adoption or custody rather than inferring them. Confirm external owner and point of need against DEP-001 and OI-021.

items.text: The staged increment retains independent App core-loop work, the complete first connected activity and distinct local/external examination contributions, without PEC or Domains as initial prerequisites or a first-host pass as proof of longer-work recovery. The account identifies actual required input standing rather than inferring readiness from defined contracts. Verified by VER-006 (REQ-006; CLM-006; B; D decision 05; P §2.3/3.1/8).

verification.text: Review the staged contribution/examination account against D decision 05, P §2.3/3.1/8 and CLM-006. Confirm the initial path can proceed without PEC/Domains and independent App work is preserved. Trace each dependent connected activity to its actual inputs; check that separate qualification and later increments remain visible and no partial slice claims the whole program.

items.text: OUT-003 binds actual observations to candidate, configuration/model/server and date, records missing/negative/unknown outcomes honestly and distinguishes them from fulfilled required witness behavior. Changed candidates reopen affected checks; browser/replay evidence does not substitute for required native or actual connected execution, and favorable approval is not inferred. Verified by VER-007 (REQ-007; E §1–2 and V4-EXM-14).

verification.text: Audit the witness evidence against E §1–2: candidate/configuration/date, invented verification material, actual run versus replay/native/browser provenance, scenario outcome and remaining gaps. For revisions, trace affected checks to the new candidate and verify criterion preservation. A completed witness claim fails if it rests only on static inspection, handoff, historical component pass or honest not-run evidence.

items.text: The completed increment contract and external account preserve each excluded act's owner under REQ-008 and retain the integration owner's complete joined responsibility, without resolving pending policies, assuming a common shared implementation or claiming acceptance, release, replacement or professional reliance from definition work. Verified by VER-008 (CLM-002…006; REQ-008; B; H §1; C).

verification.text: Review every act enumerated in REQ-008 against its cited owner claim and source. Check all output and matrix assignments for ownership transfer, fabricated acceptance, unruled operation policy, fixed shared construction or replacement/reliance inference. Return any exact source mismatch for disposition rather than silently choosing a different commitment.
